import YulangClosure.HigherOrderEntry

namespace YulangClosure.HigherOrder.Safety
open YulangClosure.HigherOrder

/-! Candidate operational research model. Events retain metadata syntactically;
no theorem below identifies this ledger with receipt/path/owner behavior. -/

inductive ThunkForm : Value → Prop where
  | delay (body : Comp) : ThunkForm (.delay body)
  | view : ThunkForm v → ThunkForm (.view v occurrence)

inductive CallableForm : Value → Prop where
  | lambda (mode receipt a b r body consumer) :
      CallableForm (.lambda mode receipt a b r body consumer)
  | wrap : CallableForm f → CallableForm (.wrap f input output)
  | view : CallableForm v → CallableForm (.view v occurrence)

inductive UnionForm : Value → Prop where
  | left (v : Value) : UnionForm (.inLeft v)
  | right (v : Value) : UnionForm (.inRight v)
  | view : UnionForm v → UnionForm (.view v occurrence)

inductive IntersectionForm : Value → Prop where
  | both (v : Value) : IntersectionForm (.both v)
  | view : IntersectionForm v → IntersectionForm (.view v occurrence)

theorem thunk_canonical (h : ValueTyped emptyContext v (.thunk a)) : ThunkForm v := by
  cases h with
  | var h => cases h
  | delay _ => exact .delay _
  | view h => exact .view (thunk_canonical h)

theorem callable_canonical (h : ValueTyped emptyContext v (.callable a b)) : CallableForm v := by
  cases h with
  | var h => cases h
  | lambdaValue _ _ => exact .lambda _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  | lambdaComputation _ _ => exact .lambda _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  | wrap h _ _ => exact .wrap (callable_canonical h)
  | view h => exact .view (callable_canonical h)

theorem union_canonical (h : ValueTyped emptyContext v (.union a b)) : UnionForm v := by
  cases h with
  | var h => cases h
  | inLeft _ => exact .left _
  | inRight _ => exact .right _
  | view h => exact .view (union_canonical h)

theorem intersection_canonical (h : ValueTyped emptyContext v (.intersection a b)) :
    IntersectionForm v := by
  cases h with
  | var h => cases h
  | both _ _ => exact .both _
  | view h => exact .view (intersection_canonical h)

theorem bottom_empty (h : ValueTyped emptyContext v .bottom) : False := by
  cases h with
  | var h => cases h
  | view h => exact bottom_empty h

/-- Complete annotations are retained as data, without claiming their semantic
adequacy. A view observation is an explicit transition, never silent erasure. -/
inductive Event where
  | silent
  | observeView (occurrence : ViewOccurrence)
  | lambdaEntry (plan : LambdaEntryPlan)
  | wrapEntry (plan : WrapEntryPlan)
  | leaveScope (owner : Nat)
  | leaveExpose (effectView resultView : ViewOccurrence)

/-- Independent operational rules: no rule contains a typing or safety premise.
Only the left side of bind and bodies of scope/expose are evaluation contexts. -/
inductive Step : Comp → Event → Comp → Prop where
  | force : Step (.force (.delay body)) .silent body
  | forceView : Step (.force (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.force v)
  | bindReturn : Step (.bind (.ret v) body) .silent (substComp (single v) body)
  | bind : Step m e n → Step (.bind m body) e (.bind n body)
  | unionLeft : Step (.unionCase (.inLeft v) l r) .silent (substComp (single v) l)
  | unionRight : Step (.unionCase (.inRight v) l r) .silent (substComp (single v) r)
  | unionView : Step (.unionCase (.view v o) l r) (.observeView o) (.unionCase v l r)
  | chooseLeft : Step (.chooseLeft (.both v)) .silent (.ret v)
  | chooseRight : Step (.chooseRight (.both v)) .silent (.ret v)
  | chooseLeftView : Step (.chooseLeft (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.chooseLeft v)
  | chooseRightView : Step (.chooseRight (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.chooseRight v)
  | scope : Step m e n → Step (.scope owner m) e (.scope owner n)
  | scopeReturn : Step (.scope owner (.ret v)) (.leaveScope owner) (.ret v)
  | expose : Step m e n → Step (.expose ev rv m) e (.expose ev rv n)
  | exposeReturn : Step (.expose ev rv (.ret v)) (.leaveExpose ev rv) (.ret v)
  | callView : Step (.dynamicCall (.view f o) arg) (.observeView o) (.dynamicCall f arg)
  | callLambda :
      Step (.dynamicCall (.lambda mode receipt a b r body consumer) carrier)
        (.lambdaEntry ⟨mode, receipt, a, b, r, body, consumer, carrier⟩)
        (LambdaEntryPlan.computation ⟨mode, receipt, a, b, r, body, consumer, carrier⟩)
  | callWrap :
      Step (.dynamicCall (.wrap inner input output) carrier)
        (.wrapEntry ⟨inner, input, output, carrier⟩)
        (WrapEntryPlan.computation ⟨inner, input, output, carrier⟩)

/-- Only explicit failure or an unhandled operation suspends execution. The
whole enclosing evaluation context and the original response binder remain. -/
inductive Suspended : Comp → Prop where
  | request (op payload continuation) : Suspended (.request op payload continuation)
  | fail (reason) : Suspended (.fail reason)
  | bind : Suspended m → Suspended (.bind m body)
  | scope : Suspended m → Suspended (.scope owner m)
  | expose : Suspended m → Suspended (.expose ev rv m)

inductive Returned : Comp → Prop where
  | ret (v : Value) : Returned (.ret v)

def CanProgress (m : Comp) : Prop :=
  Returned m ∨ Suspended m ∨ ∃ e n, Step m e n

theorem preservation (step : Step m e n) (h : CompTyped env m a) : CompTyped env n a := by
  induction step generalizing env a with
  | force =>
      cases h with
      | force hv => cases hv with | delay hb => exact hb
  | forceView =>
      cases h with
      | force hv => cases hv with | view hv => exact .force hv
  | bindReturn =>
      cases h with
      | bind hv hb => cases hv with | ret hv => exact substitute_top hb hv
  | bind _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | bind hm hb => exact .bind (ih hm) hb
  | unionLeft =>
      cases h with
      | unionCase hv hl _ => cases hv with | inLeft hv => exact substitute_top hl hv
  | unionRight =>
      cases h with
      | unionCase hv _ hr => cases hv with | inRight hv => exact substitute_top hr hv
  | unionView =>
      cases h with
      | unionCase hv hl hr => cases hv with | view hv => exact .unionCase hv hl hr
  | chooseLeft =>
      cases h with
      | chooseLeft hv => cases hv with | both hl _ => exact .ret hl
  | chooseRight =>
      cases h with
      | chooseRight hv => cases hv with | both _ hr => exact .ret hr
  | chooseLeftView =>
      cases h with
      | chooseLeft hv => cases hv with | view hv => exact .chooseLeft hv
  | chooseRightView =>
      cases h with
      | chooseRight hv => cases hv with | view hv => exact .chooseRight hv
  | scope _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | scope hm => exact .scope (ih hm)
  | scopeReturn =>
      cases h with
      | scope hm => exact hm
  | expose _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | expose hm => exact .expose (ih hm)
  | exposeReturn =>
      cases h with
      | expose hm => exact hm
  | callView =>
      cases h with
      | dynamicCall hf ha => cases hf with | view hf => exact .dynamicCall hf ha
  | callLambda =>
      cases h with
      | dynamicCall hf ha =>
          cases hf with
          | lambdaValue hb hc => exact lambda_value_plan_typed _ hb hc ha
          | lambdaComputation hb hc => exact lambda_computation_plan_typed _ hb hc ha
  | callWrap =>
      cases h with
      | dynamicCall hf ha =>
          cases hf with
          | wrap hf hi ho => exact wrap_plan_typed hf hi ho ha

theorem closed_progress (h : CompTyped emptyContext m a) : CanProgress m := by
  cases h with
  | ret _ => exact .inl (.ret _)
  | force hv =>
      cases thunk_canonical hv with
      | delay _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .force⟩)
      | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .forceView⟩)
  | bind hm hb =>
      rcases closed_progress hm with hr | hs | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases hr
        exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .bindReturn⟩)
      · exact .inr (.inl (.bind hs))
      · exact .inr (.inr ⟨e, _, .bind step⟩)
  | unionCase hv hl hr =>
      cases union_canonical hv with
      | left _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .unionLeft⟩)
      | right _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .unionRight⟩)
      | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .unionView⟩)
  | chooseLeft hv =>
      cases intersection_canonical hv with
      | both _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .chooseLeft⟩)
      | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .chooseLeftView⟩)
  | chooseRight hv =>
      cases intersection_canonical hv with
      | both _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .chooseRight⟩)
      | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .chooseRightView⟩)
  | absurd hv => exact False.elim (bottom_empty hv)
  | scope hm =>
      rcases closed_progress hm with hr | hs | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases hr
        exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .scopeReturn⟩)
      · exact .inr (.inl (.scope hs))
      · exact .inr (.inr ⟨e, _, .scope step⟩)
  | expose hm =>
      rcases closed_progress hm with hr | hs | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases hr
        exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .exposeReturn⟩)
      · exact .inr (.inl (.expose hs))
      · exact .inr (.inr ⟨e, _, .expose step⟩)
  | request _ _ => exact .inr (.inl (.request _ _ _))
  | fail => exact .inr (.inl (.fail _))
  | dynamicCall hf ha =>
      cases callable_canonical hf with
      | lambda _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .callLambda⟩)
      | wrap _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .callWrap⟩)
      | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .callView⟩)

theorem returned_no_step (h : Returned m) : ¬ Step m e n := by
  intro step
  cases h
  cases step

theorem suspended_no_step (h : Suspended m) : ¬ Step m e n := by
  intro step
  induction h generalizing e n with
  | request => cases step
  | fail => cases step
  | bind hs ih =>
      cases step with
      | bindReturn => cases hs
      | bind step => exact ih step
  | scope hs ih =>
      cases step with
      | scopeReturn => cases hs
      | scope step => exact ih step
  | expose hs ih =>
      cases step with
      | exposeReturn => cases hs
      | expose step => exact ih step

/-- Contexts capture only the actual evaluation positions; neither delayed
bodies nor request continuations are evaluated before their entry event. -/
inductive EvalContext where
  | hole
  | bind (inner : EvalContext) (body : Comp)
  | scope (owner : Nat) (inner : EvalContext)
  | expose (ev rv : ViewOccurrence) (inner : EvalContext)

def EvalContext.plug : EvalContext → Comp → Comp
  | .hole, m => m
  | .bind k body, m => .bind (k.plug m) body
  | .scope owner k, m => .scope owner (k.plug m)
  | .expose ev rv k, m => .expose ev rv (k.plug m)

inductive ContextTyped (env : Context) : EvalContext → Ty → Ty → Prop where
  | hole : ContextTyped env .hole a a
  | bind : ContextTyped env k a b → CompTyped (extend env b) body c →
      ContextTyped env (.bind k body) a c
  | scope : ContextTyped env k a b → ContextTyped env (.scope owner k) a b
  | expose : ContextTyped env k a b → ContextTyped env (.expose ev rv k) a b

theorem plug_typed (hk : ContextTyped env k a b) (hm : CompTyped env m a) :
    CompTyped env (k.plug m) b := by
  induction hk with
  | hole => exact hm
  | bind _ hb ih => exact .bind ih hb
  | scope _ ih => exact .scope ih
  | expose _ ih => exact .expose ih

theorem context_inversion (k : EvalContext) (h : CompTyped env (k.plug m) b) :
    ∃ a, CompTyped env m a ∧ ContextTyped env k a b := by
  induction k generalizing b with
  | hole => exact ⟨_, h, .hole⟩
  | bind k body ih =>
      cases h with
      | bind hm hb =>
          obtain ⟨a, hm, hk⟩ := ih hm
          exact ⟨a, hm, .bind hk hb⟩
  | scope owner k ih =>
      cases h with
      | scope hm =>
          obtain ⟨a, hm, hk⟩ := ih hm
          exact ⟨a, hm, .scope hk⟩
  | expose ev rv k ih =>
      cases h with
      | expose hm =>
          obtain ⟨a, hm, hk⟩ := ih hm
          exact ⟨a, hm, .expose hk⟩

/-- A suspension has a concrete failure or request at a finite context hole.
This is not an extra rule declaring arbitrary stuck terms terminal. -/
theorem suspended_decomposition (h : Suspended m) :
    (∃ k reason, m = k.plug (.fail reason)) ∨
    (∃ k op payload continuation, m = k.plug (.request op payload continuation)) := by
  induction h with
  | request op payload continuation =>
      exact .inr ⟨.hole, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
  | fail reason => exact .inl ⟨.hole, reason, rfl⟩
  | bind _ ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨k, reason, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
      · exact .inl ⟨.bind k _, reason, rfl⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨.bind k _, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
  | scope _ ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨k, reason, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
      · exact .inl ⟨.scope _ k, reason, rfl⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨.scope _ k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
  | expose _ ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨k, reason, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
      · exact .inl ⟨.expose _ _ k, reason, rfl⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨.expose _ _ k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩

/-- The finite trace stores every emitted event in execution order. -/
inductive Steps : Comp → List Event → Comp → Prop where
  | refl (m) : Steps m [] m
  | cons : Step m e n → Steps n trace last → Steps m (e :: trace) last

theorem trace_preservation (steps : Steps m trace n) (h : CompTyped env m a) :
    CompTyped env n a := by
  cases steps with
  | refl => exact h
  | cons step rest => exact trace_preservation rest (preservation step h)

/-- Quantifies over every finite prefix, not a selected successful execution. -/
theorem finite_prefix_safety (h : CompTyped emptyContext m a) (steps : Steps m trace n) :
    CompTyped emptyContext n a ∧ CanProgress n := by
  have hn := trace_preservation steps h
  exact ⟨hn, closed_progress hn⟩

/-- An actual operation response remains independently quantified. -/
theorem resume_request_typed
    (h : CompTyped env (.request op payload continuation) a)
    (response : Value) (hr : ValueTyped env response op.responseType) :
    CompTyped env (substComp (single response) continuation) a := by
  cases h with
  | request _ hk => exact substitute_top hk hr

/-- Independent response and enclosing-context quantifiers are both retained.
No local lambda action stands in for the foreign continuation. -/
theorem resume_in_context_typed (k : EvalContext)
    (h : CompTyped env (k.plug (.request op payload continuation)) a)
    (response : Value) (hr : ValueTyped env response op.responseType) :
    CompTyped env (k.plug (substComp (single response) continuation)) a := by
  obtain ⟨b, hm, hk⟩ := context_inversion k h
  exact plug_typed hk (resume_request_typed hm response hr)

/-- Viewed Force is represented explicitly, with the exact occurrence retained. -/
theorem viewed_force (v : Value) (o : ViewOccurrence) :
    Step (.force (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.force v) := .forceView

/-- Computation entry passes the original thunk without forcing it. -/
theorem computation_entry_equation (receipt a b r body consumer carrier) :
    (LambdaEntryPlan.mk .computation receipt a b r body consumer carrier).computation =
      .bind (substComp (single carrier) body) (adapterBody consumer) := rfl

/-- Value entry forces before body execution, then applies the result consumer. -/
theorem value_entry_equation (receipt a b r body consumer carrier) :
    (LambdaEntryPlan.mk .value receipt a b r body consumer carrier).computation =
      .bind (.bind (.force carrier) body) (adapterBody consumer) := rfl

/-- Input adaptation is inside the delayed carrier; output adaptation waits for
an inner result. This equation rules out premature argument adaptation. -/
theorem wrap_entry_equation (inner input output carrier) :
    (WrapEntryPlan.mk inner input output carrier).computation =
      .bind (.dynamicCall inner (.delay (.bind (.force carrier) (adapterBody input))))
        (adapterBody output) := rfl

end YulangClosure.HigherOrder.Safety

# Higher-order operational safety candidate

Status: unverified, unreviewed research candidate; no production authority.
Author: `/root/higher_order_safety_astra_r1`; requested Astra/medium,
observed model/effort UNKNOWN. Contract PARALLEL-THEORY-20261025/r1,
SHA-256 `0751276e8eedf50d113475a0ef1c41b27b7ffd77cc4ccc28761e3cc9e792ff76`.

## Parent and exact domain

The parent is operational safety for every constructor of the accepted finite
`HigherOrderSyntax.lean` research grammar. The stronger full-language/native
safety and original Simple-sub A/B obligations remain OPEN. This candidate
introduces an independent, explicitly defined research transition relation;
it does not infer operational adequacy from the structural embedding or from
successful typing of entry plans. The operational paper remains a proposal.

`Safety.preservation` quantifies over every context, computation, type, event and
raw `Step` derivation. No transition premise contains typing, preservation,
progress or body safety. `closed_progress` quantifies over every closed typing
derivation. `finite_prefix_safety` quantifies over every finite labelled trace,
including the empty trace; its endpoint retains the original type and is a
return, a concrete suspended request/failure, or has another transition.
Explicit failure is an admitted terminal outcome, not an excluded runtime error.
The theorem proves safety, not termination, successful completion, or absence
of explicit failures.

## Operational construction and parent application

Thunks, callable lambdas/wrappers, unions and intersections have recursive
canonical forms through any finite nest of views. A closed bottom value is
impossible. These lemmas are applied directly in closed progress. In particular,
a typed dynamic call cannot reach a literal/noncallable head, and a viewed thunk
has a specific Force transition rather than being omitted from the theorem.

The raw transition relation evaluates only the first computation of bind and
the bodies of scope/expose. It substitutes at bind/union selection, projects
single-child intersections, and enters callable lambda/wrap plans. Scope and
expose remain syntactically active around the executing computation, including
around a suspended operation. A return exits them with an event carrying their
exact annotations. No rules execute inside delay, lambda body, adapter body,
request continuation or the delayed wrap input before the appropriate entry.

Value-mode entry first forces the carrier and binds the returned value into the
body. Computation-mode entry substitutes the original carrier without forcing.
Both then bind the body result into the separate result consumer. A wrap delays
input adaptation inside the carrier passed to the inner call; its output adapter
runs only after the inner result. Definitional equations expose these orders.
Existing checked entry-plan typing and simultaneous substitution supply the
one-step typing proof. Preservation is then applied along each actual finite
trace, and progress is applied to the preserved endpoint. Neither arbitrary
body safety nor an assumed safe-transition supplier appears in these proofs.

`Suspended` is restricted to an explicit failure/request under the three actual
evaluation contexts. `suspended_decomposition` extracts the concrete terminal
node and finite context. Requests retain their operation instance, payload,
continuation and response binder; arbitrary stuck computations cannot become
terminal by definition. `returned_no_step` and `suspended_no_step` establish that
these states really lack an internal transition.

`context_inversion` and `plug_typed` supply the missing context argument for
resumption. `resume_in_context_typed` quantifies independently over every
retained context and every response value typed at the operation response type.
It substitutes the response into the actual request continuation and reinstalls
the entire context. Internal traces exclude external responses; this separate
lemma supplies typed resumption, not authenticity of externally received data.
It does not discharge F1/FK1 or arbitrary foreign native continuation claims.

## Metadata boundary: retention is not adequacy

Each observed view emits its exact `ViewOccurrence`. Lambda entry emits the
complete `LambdaEntryPlan`, including receipt, annotated types, body, consumer
and carrier. Wrap entry emits both complete adapters and the carrier. These
objects retain paths, views and proof-valued path correspondence. `Steps` keeps
all events in execution order. Original annotations are thus available in the
trace even when a computation projection uses `adapterBody`.

This is **syntactic historical retention only**. View observation advances to
the underlying eliminand and records the occurrence; it does not establish the
view's live propagation, licensing, receipt emission, provider ownership,
path mapping or owner discharge. The ledger model is an explicit candidate
semantics, not evidence that discarding those obligations in the real language
is valid. In particular the permissive `PathRule.adapterMap` and absent runtime
map identity remain untouched. Safety of this model cannot prove the paper's
full view/receipt semantics, source authenticity or compiler correctness.

The exact remaining adequacy premise is a relation between actual source/native
states and this annotated transition system that preserves active view/receipt/
owner behavior and covers every actual successor, request instance and response.
If ledger observations cannot represent that behavior, this operational model
needs a separately authorized semantic refinement before application. The full
parent must not be marked closed by the candidate's internal progress theorem.

## Coverage and falsifiers

Every Value/Comp/Adapter constructor of the accepted finite grammar is covered
by typing plus the progress proof. Literal payloads, top/injection/intersection
wrappers and nested callables are retained. Adapters enter through their actual
bodies using the frozen substitution/entry constructions. There is no recursion
primitive or immutable graph representation here; the independent graph lane
owns that separate extension, which is not imported.

The primary should check every declaration and its axiom list, then distinguish:
viewed Force; nested viewed callables; rejected literal application typing;
value versus computation entry; wrap input/output order and inert argument;
request response binder; consumer-after-body order; scope/expose around request;
and arbitrary typed response under an outer bind. Any missing typed constructor,
typing premise in `Step`, prematurely executed carrier/input adapter, missing
request/context field or unsupported metadata-adequacy claim falsifies the
corresponding result. No checker, build or test was run by this author.

## Dependencies, reuse and next owners

Frozen direct imports/reuse:

| Artifact | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| HigherOrderSyntax.lean | ea727d33692bdcbe6b40245b960d01225b556b5334ffab649eea2699930d5972 |
| HigherOrderSubstitution.lean | 19910452c45b20761ec06dc7e15f94c94b95014ff00f3f5296af005b9adf6f30 |
| HigherOrderEnvironment.lean | 84a461fdff85e7321cf090ba2bb72a7d90415515a2da1eb15e1287ef0361ab83 |
| HigherOrderEntry.lean | c9cb839ff6b34ed97c5d72f9e020437d32175cf517a5841a3a024764747c213b |
| Higher-order core design | 50eb7ebd2ed2d155dfeca2e3ce99f3f5b990cc4f1bf101663949a04d8d4b748f |
| Substitution/entry primary verification receipt | 8e5c0f3b8be37879f9009b8e5ed57a2911b6d130e3ae690fc66a3e43554a5a25 |

The three new dependencies were explicitly frozen and supplied by the primary
as Lean PASS with independent review pending. Their producer and primary repair
provenance remains in the substitution-entry assignment/outcome; this author is
not their independent reviewer. Historical first-order safety is not extended
by analogy; no old failure or assumed-transition test is used as adequacy proof.

TODO HO-SAFETY-CHECK-1: primary checks this exact candidate, repairs only after
acknowledged writer STOP, and appoints fresh independent review. Falsifier:
failed elaboration, prohibited axiom, uncovered typed constructor or circular
operational premise. No production edit is requested.

TODO HO-METADATA-ADEQUACY-1: primary owns the separate source/native and semantic
intake. Required evidence relates the source Lambda/Name/Apply and native
`Instruction::Lambda`, `Frame::ValueEntry`, `Machine::lookup`, `Machine::extend`,
Callee/Computation entry, request capture/replay and consumer owners to the
retained operational annotations and actual successor relation. These owners
are inherited locators, not a fresh audit by this author. Falsifier: an actual
accepted step whose view/receipt/owner effect or response binding has no matching
annotated transition. Missing evidence requires an explicit new packet; no code,
source-domain restriction or Simple-sub inference change is authorized here.

Only the three assigned research/handoff paths were written. No scratch files,
Git operations, background processes, checker calls, descendants or compiler
edits were created. The frozen handoff records exact artifact hashes and STOP.

# Higher-order research core and structural embedding

Status: Draft research construction; checking and review evidence is recorded in
the sprint outcome and its frozen receipts. This is not production authority.
Scope: frozen LEAN-HIGHER-ORDER-PROOF-CORE-20261025/r1 research representation.
Initial author: /root/higher_order_proof_core_astra_r1; requested gpt-6-astra/medium,
observed model/effort UNKNOWN. Primary /root repairs and integrates after author
STOP; the outcome records final authorship and independent review. No descendants.
Production authority: none. The operational paper is a proposal/target; the
2026-10-07 complete-Call definition §1 records permission for legitimate research
definitions, not adoption of this representation as compiler architecture.

The parent RESPONSE-ENCODING-1 / ENV-CALLABLE-1 lacked a callable constructor in
its formal Value sort. The candidate removes that specific representational
obstruction by constructing a new callable type and actual lambda/wrap values.
Every Original.Val/Comp and TypedCall.Value/Comp/Adapter/Function constructor is
mapped structurally. No old term is retained behind an opaque original opcode.
The full parent, native readback and operational safety remain OPEN.

## Syntax and quantifiers

`HigherOrderSyntax.lean` retains every old type constructor, all eight literal
domains and their exact payload representations, variables, delay, injections,
single-child intersection/top values and all seven Original computations. It
adds the existing Call view/scope/expose/request/fail nodes, lambda/wrap values,
and dynamicCall. Request's continuation binds its operation instance's response
type. The type language can place callable types beneath thunk/union/intersection
and in operation instances. The value, computation and adapter syntax is mutually
inductive; all typing judgments are defined afterwards.

Value-entry lambda binds A; computation-entry lambda binds Thunk A. Both retain
receipt, annotated input/body/result types, body and result consumer. Wrap keeps
the input adapter c→a and output adapter b→d around an a→b function. DynamicCall
accepts a thunk carrier. This fixes a research typing interface without asserting
an execution rule or operational equivalence for the new constructor.

`ContextEmbedding old new` quantifies over every old lookup fact. The mutual
Original and TypedCall preservation proofs quantify over arbitrary old terms,
old typing derivations and target contexts satisfying that relation. Closed
Original nodes embed under any target context using the empty lookup relation;
binders use `extend_embedding`. The Function theorem quantifies over every old
FunctionTyped derivation and every target context. No original constructor,
source-domain restriction or independent continuation quantifier is discarded.
This is one-way typing preservation, not reflection or full conservativity.

## Metadata boundary

Paths retain component lists, port kinds and translated endpoint types;
occurrences retain identities and paths. Operation instances retain operation
identity, ordered type arguments and both payload/response types. Receipt slots
and profiles retain order, identity and typed paths. Adapter metadata retains
all path correspondences and captured occurrences. Interface-port metadata also
has a structural map.

PathRule is a Prop in the accepted input. `embedPathRule` translates its proof
into a new Prop proof. It does not eliminate that proof into a data-valued map
identity. In particular the old permissive adapterMap rule remains permissive;
this work cannot prove that a mappingIdentity absent from runtime data can be
reconstructed. Syntax is **typing-proof-free**, not entirely proof-free. The old
Adapter.typed field is omitted from syntax and consumed solely to construct the
new extrinsic AdapterTyped derivation. The retained PathRule metadata neither
contains a typing judgment nor creates a typing-definition cycle.

## Parent application

`embedFunction_typed` constructs a ValueTyped callable from an old FunctionTyped
proof. `function_as_argument` and `call_with_function_argument` use it in the
actual new delayed argument and dynamicCall constructors.
`request_callable_response` constructs a request that binds and returns a
callable-typed response. `function_cell` pushes the embedded function into the
existing generic NativeClosureEnvironment.Store, proves the actual current cell
equality and supplies its callable typing derivation.

`read_embedding` preserves the exact old selected cell address while mapping the
current store pointwise. `read_embedding_typed` combines that equation with the
accepted `successful_read_typed` theorem. `captured_value_typed` applies the
accepted `realized_substitution_typed` supplier to each represented context index;
`captured_body_typed` applies its actual successful capture and closed-body
construction before embedding. Both keep successful realization and CellsTyped
as explicit original premises. Nothing claims that arbitrary native closures
already satisfy those premises, or that old stores already represent new
callable values. Generic new callable storage and old represented-read transport
are two separate constructions whose native connection is still open.

## Remaining source obligations and reuse

Accepted CoreSyntax typing and CallEnvironmentRealization supply precisely their
existing domains. CoreSubstitution's bind/request lifting is reused through
close_body, without reproving lookup or assuming a new substitution rule. The
NativeClosureEnvironment.Store remains generic; no machine fields change.
Historical literal readback is not extended to callable readback by analogy.
No failure is dismissed by a narrower theorem; no new source restriction,
Simple-sub bypass or production implementation is introduced.

Luna/source intake owns ENV-LAYOUT-1 (resolved free-variable order and binder
indices from source Lambda/Name/Apply), ENV-CELL-VALUE-1 (current native Value
encoding), ENV-GRAPH-1 (recursive cell/closure graphs), ENV-CALLABLE-1's remaining
native body/consumer mapping, and ENV-DISPATCH-1. Relevant native owners remain
machine.rs `Instruction::Lambda`, `Frame::ValueEntry`, `Machine::lookup`,
`Machine::extend`, closure/Callee branches and receiving.rs lambda schema
construction. The primary's disjoint source map gives their complete exact
producer/consumer inventory, including unit/record/default entry cases.
Force, native transitions, new-core substitution/progress/preservation,
whole-trace safety, operation authenticity and original inference A/B remain
OPEN. No F1/FK1 or foreign-continuation theorem is claimed here.

inspection, distinguishing examples, repairs after author STOP and fresh
independent review. Author/coauthor cannot independently certify this candidate.

background processes, descendants, compiler changes or Git operations.

import YulangClosure.HigherOrderEntry

namespace YulangClosure.HigherOrder.Safety
open YulangClosure.HigherOrder

/-! Candidate operational research model. Events retain metadata syntactically;
no theorem below identifies this ledger with receipt/path/owner behavior. -/

inductive ThunkForm : Value → Prop where
  | delay (body : Comp) : ThunkForm (.delay body)
  | view : ThunkForm v → ThunkForm (.view v occurrence)

inductive CallableForm : Value → Prop where
  | lambda (mode receipt a b r body consumer) :
      CallableForm (.lambda mode receipt a b r body consumer)
  | wrap : CallableForm f → CallableForm (.wrap f input output)
  | view : CallableForm v → CallableForm (.view v occurrence)

inductive UnionForm : Value → Prop where
  | left (v : Value) : UnionForm (.inLeft v)
  | right (v : Value) : UnionForm (.inRight v)
  | view : UnionForm v → UnionForm (.view v occurrence)

inductive IntersectionForm : Value → Prop where
  | both (v : Value) : IntersectionForm (.both v)
  | view : IntersectionForm v → IntersectionForm (.view v occurrence)

theorem thunk_canonical (h : ValueTyped emptyContext v (.thunk a)) : ThunkForm v := by
  cases h with
  | var h => cases h
  | delay _ => exact .delay _
  | view h => exact .view (thunk_canonical h)

theorem callable_canonical (h : ValueTyped emptyContext v (.callable a b)) : CallableForm v := by
  cases h with
  | var h => cases h
  | lambdaValue _ _ => exact .lambda _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  | lambdaComputation _ _ => exact .lambda _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  | wrap h _ _ => exact .wrap (callable_canonical h)
  | view h => exact .view (callable_canonical h)

theorem union_canonical (h : ValueTyped emptyContext v (.union a b)) : UnionForm v := by
  cases h with
  | var h => cases h
  | inLeft _ => exact .left _
  | inRight _ => exact .right _
  | view h => exact .view (union_canonical h)

theorem intersection_canonical (h : ValueTyped emptyContext v (.intersection a b)) :
    IntersectionForm v := by
  cases h with
  | var h => cases h
  | both _ _ => exact .both _
  | view h => exact .view (intersection_canonical h)

theorem bottom_empty (h : ValueTyped emptyContext v .bottom) : False := by
  cases h with
  | var h => cases h
  | view h => exact bottom_empty h

/-- Complete annotations are retained as data, without claiming their semantic
adequacy. A view observation is an explicit transition, never silent erasure. -/
inductive Event where
  | silent
  | observeView (occurrence : ViewOccurrence)
  | lambdaEntry (plan : LambdaEntryPlan)
  | wrapEntry (plan : WrapEntryPlan)
  | leaveScope (owner : Nat)
  | leaveExpose (effectView resultView : ViewOccurrence)

/-- Independent operational rules: no rule contains a typing or safety premise.
Only the left side of bind and bodies of scope/expose are evaluation contexts. -/
inductive Step : Comp → Event → Comp → Prop where
  | force : Step (.force (.delay body)) .silent body
  | forceView : Step (.force (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.force v)
  | bindReturn : Step (.bind (.ret v) body) .silent (substComp (single v) body)
  | bind : Step m e n → Step (.bind m body) e (.bind n body)
  | unionLeft : Step (.unionCase (.inLeft v) l r) .silent (substComp (single v) l)
  | unionRight : Step (.unionCase (.inRight v) l r) .silent (substComp (single v) r)
  | unionView : Step (.unionCase (.view v o) l r) (.observeView o) (.unionCase v l r)
  | chooseLeft : Step (.chooseLeft (.both v)) .silent (.ret v)
  | chooseRight : Step (.chooseRight (.both v)) .silent (.ret v)
  | chooseLeftView : Step (.chooseLeft (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.chooseLeft v)
  | chooseRightView : Step (.chooseRight (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.chooseRight v)
  | scope : Step m e n → Step (.scope owner m) e (.scope owner n)
  | scopeReturn : Step (.scope owner (.ret v)) (.leaveScope owner) (.ret v)
  | expose : Step m e n → Step (.expose ev rv m) e (.expose ev rv n)
  | exposeReturn : Step (.expose ev rv (.ret v)) (.leaveExpose ev rv) (.ret v)
  | callView : Step (.dynamicCall (.view f o) arg) (.observeView o) (.dynamicCall f arg)
  | callLambda :
      Step (.dynamicCall (.lambda mode receipt a b r body consumer) carrier)
        (.lambdaEntry ⟨mode, receipt, a, b, r, body, consumer, carrier⟩)
        (LambdaEntryPlan.computation ⟨mode, receipt, a, b, r, body, consumer, carrier⟩)
  | callWrap :
      Step (.dynamicCall (.wrap inner input output) carrier)
        (.wrapEntry ⟨inner, input, output, carrier⟩)
        (WrapEntryPlan.computation ⟨inner, input, output, carrier⟩)

/-- Only explicit failure or an unhandled operation suspends execution. The
whole enclosing evaluation context and the original response binder remain. -/
inductive Suspended : Comp → Prop where
  | request (op payload continuation) : Suspended (.request op payload continuation)
  | fail (reason) : Suspended (.fail reason)
  | bind : Suspended m → Suspended (.bind m body)
  | scope : Suspended m → Suspended (.scope owner m)
  | expose : Suspended m → Suspended (.expose ev rv m)

inductive Returned : Comp → Prop where
  | ret (v : Value) : Returned (.ret v)

def CanProgress (m : Comp) : Prop :=
  Returned m ∨ Suspended m ∨ ∃ e n, Step m e n

theorem preservation (step : Step m e n) (h : CompTyped env m a) : CompTyped env n a := by
  induction step generalizing env a with
  | force =>
      cases h with
      | force hv => cases hv with | delay hb => exact hb
  | forceView =>
      cases h with
      | force hv => cases hv with | view hv => exact .force hv
  | bindReturn =>
      cases h with
      | bind hv hb => cases hv with | ret hv => exact substitute_top hb hv
  | bind _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | bind hm hb => exact .bind (ih hm) hb
  | unionLeft =>
      cases h with
      | unionCase hv hl _ => cases hv with | inLeft hv => exact substitute_top hl hv
  | unionRight =>
      cases h with
      | unionCase hv _ hr => cases hv with | inRight hv => exact substitute_top hr hv
  | unionView =>
      cases h with
      | unionCase hv hl hr => cases hv with | view hv => exact .unionCase hv hl hr
  | chooseLeft =>
      cases h with
      | chooseLeft hv => cases hv with | both hl _ => exact .ret hl
  | chooseRight =>
      cases h with
      | chooseRight hv => cases hv with | both _ hr => exact .ret hr
  | chooseLeftView =>
      cases h with
      | chooseLeft hv => cases hv with | view hv => exact .chooseLeft hv
  | chooseRightView =>
      cases h with
      | chooseRight hv => cases hv with | view hv => exact .chooseRight hv
  | scope _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | scope hm => exact .scope (ih hm)
  | scopeReturn =>
      cases h with
      | scope hm => exact hm
  | expose _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | expose hm => exact .expose (ih hm)
  | exposeReturn =>
      cases h with
      | expose hm => exact hm
  | callView =>
      cases h with
      | dynamicCall hf ha => cases hf with | view hf => exact .dynamicCall hf ha
  | callLambda =>
      cases h with
      | dynamicCall hf ha =>
          cases hf with
          | lambdaValue hb hc => exact lambda_value_plan_typed _ hb hc ha
          | lambdaComputation hb hc => exact lambda_computation_plan_typed _ hb hc ha
  | callWrap =>
      cases h with
      | dynamicCall hf ha =>
          cases hf with
          | wrap hf hi ho => exact wrap_plan_typed hf hi ho ha

theorem closed_progress (h : CompTyped emptyContext m a) : CanProgress m := by
  cases h with
  | ret _ => exact .inl (.ret _)
  | force hv =>
      cases thunk_canonical hv with
      | delay _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .force⟩)
      | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .forceView⟩)
  | bind hm hb =>
      rcases closed_progress hm with hr | hs | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases hr
        exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .bindReturn⟩)
      · exact .inr (.inl (.bind hs))
      · exact .inr (.inr ⟨e, _, .bind step⟩)
  | unionCase hv hl hr =>
      cases union_canonical hv with
      | left _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .unionLeft⟩)
      | right _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .unionRight⟩)
      | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .unionView⟩)
  | chooseLeft hv =>
      cases intersection_canonical hv with
      | both _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .chooseLeft⟩)
      | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .chooseLeftView⟩)
  | chooseRight hv =>
      cases intersection_canonical hv with
      | both _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .chooseRight⟩)
      | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .chooseRightView⟩)
  | absurd hv => exact False.elim (bottom_empty hv)
  | scope hm =>
      rcases closed_progress hm with hr | hs | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases hr
        exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .scopeReturn⟩)
      · exact .inr (.inl (.scope hs))
      · exact .inr (.inr ⟨e, _, .scope step⟩)
  | expose hm =>
      rcases closed_progress hm with hr | hs | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases hr
        exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .exposeReturn⟩)
      · exact .inr (.inl (.expose hs))
      · exact .inr (.inr ⟨e, _, .expose step⟩)
  | request _ _ => exact .inr (.inl (.request _ _ _))
  | fail => exact .inr (.inl (.fail _))
  | dynamicCall hf ha =>
      cases callable_canonical hf with
      | lambda _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .callLambda⟩)
      | wrap _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .callWrap⟩)
      | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .callView⟩)

theorem returned_no_step (h : Returned m) : ¬ Step m e n := by
  intro step
  cases h
  cases step

theorem suspended_no_step (h : Suspended m) : ¬ Step m e n := by
  intro step
  induction h generalizing e n with
  | request => cases step
  | fail => cases step
  | bind hs ih =>
      cases step with
      | bindReturn => cases hs
      | bind step => exact ih step
  | scope hs ih =>
      cases step with
      | scopeReturn => cases hs
      | scope step => exact ih step
  | expose hs ih =>
      cases step with
      | exposeReturn => cases hs
      | expose step => exact ih step

/-- Contexts capture only the actual evaluation positions; neither delayed
bodies nor request continuations are evaluated before their entry event. -/
inductive EvalContext where
  | hole
  | bind (inner : EvalContext) (body : Comp)
  | scope (owner : Nat) (inner : EvalContext)
  | expose (ev rv : ViewOccurrence) (inner : EvalContext)

def EvalContext.plug : EvalContext → Comp → Comp
  | .hole, m => m
  | .bind k body, m => .bind (k.plug m) body
  | .scope owner k, m => .scope owner (k.plug m)
  | .expose ev rv k, m => .expose ev rv (k.plug m)

inductive ContextTyped (env : Context) : EvalContext → Ty → Ty → Prop where
  | hole : ContextTyped env .hole a a
  | bind : ContextTyped env k a b → CompTyped (extend env b) body c →
      ContextTyped env (.bind k body) a c
  | scope : ContextTyped env k a b → ContextTyped env (.scope owner k) a b
  | expose : ContextTyped env k a b → ContextTyped env (.expose ev rv k) a b

theorem plug_typed (hk : ContextTyped env k a b) (hm : CompTyped env m a) :
    CompTyped env (k.plug m) b := by
  induction hk with
  | hole => exact hm
  | bind _ hb ih => exact .bind (ih hm) hb
  | scope _ ih => exact .scope (ih hm)
  | expose _ ih => exact .expose (ih hm)

theorem context_inversion (k : EvalContext) (h : CompTyped env (k.plug m) b) :
    ∃ a, CompTyped env m a ∧ ContextTyped env k a b := by
  induction k generalizing b with
  | hole => exact ⟨_, h, .hole⟩
  | bind k body ih =>
      cases h with
      | bind hm hb =>
          obtain ⟨a, hm, hk⟩ := ih hm
          exact ⟨a, hm, .bind hk hb⟩
  | scope owner k ih =>
      cases h with
      | scope hm =>
          obtain ⟨a, hm, hk⟩ := ih hm
          exact ⟨a, hm, .scope hk⟩
  | expose ev rv k ih =>
      cases h with
      | expose hm =>
          obtain ⟨a, hm, hk⟩ := ih hm
          exact ⟨a, hm, .expose hk⟩

/-- A suspension has a concrete failure or request at a finite context hole.
This is not an extra rule declaring arbitrary stuck terms terminal. -/
theorem suspended_decomposition (h : Suspended m) :
    (∃ (k : EvalContext) reason, m = k.plug (.fail reason)) ∨
    (∃ (k : EvalContext) op payload continuation, m = k.plug (.request op payload continuation)) := by
  induction h with
  | request op payload continuation =>
      exact .inr ⟨.hole, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
  | fail reason => exact .inl ⟨.hole, reason, rfl⟩
  | bind _ ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨k, reason, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
      · exact .inl ⟨.bind k _, reason, rfl⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨.bind k _, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
  | scope _ ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨k, reason, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
      · exact .inl ⟨.scope _ k, reason, rfl⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨.scope _ k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
  | expose _ ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨k, reason, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
      · exact .inl ⟨.expose _ _ k, reason, rfl⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨.expose _ _ k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩

/-- The finite trace stores every emitted event in execution order. -/
inductive Steps : Comp → List Event → Comp → Prop where
  | refl (m) : Steps m [] m
  | cons : Step m e n → Steps n trace last → Steps m (e :: trace) last

theorem trace_preservation (steps : Steps m trace n) (h : CompTyped env m a) :
    CompTyped env n a := by
  induction steps generalizing env a with
  | refl => exact h
  | cons step rest ih => exact ih (preservation step h)

/-- Quantifies over every finite prefix, not a selected successful execution. -/
theorem finite_prefix_safety (h : CompTyped emptyContext m a) (steps : Steps m trace n) :
    CompTyped emptyContext n a ∧ CanProgress n := by
  have hn := trace_preservation steps h
  exact ⟨hn, closed_progress hn⟩

/-- An actual operation response remains independently quantified. -/
theorem resume_request_typed
    (h : CompTyped env (.request op payload continuation) a)
    (response : Value) (hr : ValueTyped env response op.responseType) :
    CompTyped env (substComp (single response) continuation) a := by
  cases h with
  | request _ hk => exact substitute_top hk hr

/-- Independent response and enclosing-context quantifiers are both retained.
No local lambda action stands in for the foreign continuation. -/
theorem resume_in_context_typed (k : EvalContext)
    (h : CompTyped env (k.plug (.request op payload continuation)) a)
    (response : Value) (hr : ValueTyped env response op.responseType) :
    CompTyped env (k.plug (substComp (single response) continuation)) a := by
  obtain ⟨b, hm, hk⟩ := context_inversion k h
  exact plug_typed hk (resume_request_typed hm response hr)

/-- Viewed Force is represented explicitly, with the exact occurrence retained. -/
theorem viewed_force (v : Value) (o : ViewOccurrence) :
    Step (.force (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.force v) := .forceView

/-- Computation entry passes the original thunk without forcing it. -/
theorem computation_entry_equation (receipt a b r body consumer carrier) :
    (LambdaEntryPlan.mk .computation receipt a b r body consumer carrier).computation =
      .bind (substComp (single carrier) body) (adapterBody consumer) := rfl

/-- Value entry forces before body execution, then applies the result consumer. -/
theorem value_entry_equation (receipt a b r body consumer carrier) :
    (LambdaEntryPlan.mk .value receipt a b r body consumer carrier).computation =
      .bind (.bind (.force carrier) body) (adapterBody consumer) := rfl

/-- Input adaptation is inside the delayed carrier; output adaptation waits for
an inner result. This equation rules out premature argument adaptation. -/
theorem wrap_entry_equation (inner input output carrier) :
    (WrapEntryPlan.mk inner input output carrier).computation =
      .bind (.dynamicCall inner (.delay (.bind (.force carrier) (adapterBody input))))
        (adapterBody output) := rfl

end YulangClosure.HigherOrder.Safety

# Higher-order operational safety candidate

Status: unverified, unreviewed research candidate; no production authority.
Author: `/root/higher_order_safety_astra_r1`; requested Astra/medium,
observed model/effort UNKNOWN. Contract PARALLEL-THEORY-20261025/r1,
SHA-256 `0751276e8eedf50d113475a0ef1c41b27b7ffd77cc4ccc28761e3cc9e792ff76`.

## Parent and exact domain

The parent is operational safety for every constructor of the accepted finite
`HigherOrderSyntax.lean` research grammar. The stronger full-language/native
safety and original Simple-sub A/B obligations remain OPEN. This candidate
introduces an independent, explicitly defined research transition relation;
it does not infer operational adequacy from the structural embedding or from
successful typing of entry plans. The operational paper remains a proposal.

`Safety.preservation` quantifies over every context, computation, type, event and
raw `Step` derivation. No transition premise contains typing, preservation,
progress or body safety. `closed_progress` quantifies over every closed typing
derivation. `finite_prefix_safety` quantifies over every finite labelled trace,
including the empty trace; its endpoint retains the original type and is a
return, a concrete suspended request/failure, or has another transition.
Explicit failure is an admitted terminal outcome, not an excluded runtime error.
The theorem proves safety, not termination, successful completion, or absence
of explicit failures.

## Operational construction and parent application

Thunks, callable lambdas/wrappers, unions and intersections have recursive
canonical forms through any finite nest of views. A closed bottom value is
impossible. These lemmas are applied directly in closed progress. In particular,
a typed dynamic call cannot reach a literal/noncallable head, and a viewed thunk
has a specific Force transition rather than being omitted from the theorem.

The raw transition relation evaluates only the first computation of bind and
the bodies of scope/expose. It substitutes at bind/union selection, projects
single-child intersections, and enters callable lambda/wrap plans. Scope and
expose remain syntactically active around the executing computation, including
around a suspended operation. A return exits them with an event carrying their
exact annotations. No rules execute inside delay, lambda body, adapter body,
request continuation or the delayed wrap input before the appropriate entry.

Value-mode entry first forces the carrier and binds the returned value into the
body. Computation-mode entry substitutes the original carrier without forcing.
Both then bind the body result into the separate result consumer. A wrap delays
input adaptation inside the carrier passed to the inner call; its output adapter
runs only after the inner result. Definitional equations expose these orders.
Existing checked entry-plan typing and simultaneous substitution supply the
one-step typing proof. Preservation is then applied along each actual finite
trace, and progress is applied to the preserved endpoint. Neither arbitrary
body safety nor an assumed safe-transition supplier appears in these proofs.

`Suspended` is restricted to an explicit failure/request under the three actual
evaluation contexts. `suspended_decomposition` extracts the concrete terminal
node and finite context. Requests retain their operation instance, payload,
continuation and response binder; arbitrary stuck computations cannot become
terminal by definition. `returned_no_step` and `suspended_no_step` establish that
these states really lack an internal transition.

`context_inversion` and `plug_typed` supply the missing context argument for
resumption. `resume_in_context_typed` quantifies independently over every
retained context and every response value typed at the operation response type.
It substitutes the response into the actual request continuation and reinstalls
the entire context. Internal traces exclude external responses; this separate
lemma supplies typed resumption, not authenticity of externally received data.
It does not discharge F1/FK1 or arbitrary foreign native continuation claims.

## Metadata boundary: retention is not adequacy

Each observed view emits its exact `ViewOccurrence`. Lambda entry emits the
complete `LambdaEntryPlan`, including receipt, annotated types, body, consumer
and carrier. Wrap entry emits both complete adapters and the carrier. These
objects retain paths, views and proof-valued path correspondence. `Steps` keeps
all events in execution order. Original annotations are thus available in the
trace even when a computation projection uses `adapterBody`.

This is **syntactic historical retention only**. View observation advances to
the underlying eliminand and records the occurrence; it does not establish the
view's live propagation, licensing, receipt emission, provider ownership,
path mapping or owner discharge. The ledger model is an explicit candidate
semantics, not evidence that discarding those obligations in the real language
is valid. In particular the permissive `PathRule.adapterMap` and absent runtime
map identity remain untouched. Safety of this model cannot prove the paper's
full view/receipt semantics, source authenticity or compiler correctness.

The exact remaining adequacy premise is a relation between actual source/native
states and this annotated transition system that preserves active view/receipt/
owner behavior and covers every actual successor, request instance and response.
If ledger observations cannot represent that behavior, this operational model
needs a separately authorized semantic refinement before application. The full
parent must not be marked closed by the candidate's internal progress theorem.

## Coverage and falsifiers

Every Value/Comp/Adapter constructor of the accepted finite grammar is covered
by typing plus the progress proof. Literal payloads, top/injection/intersection
wrappers and nested callables are retained. Adapters enter through their actual
bodies using the frozen substitution/entry constructions. There is no recursion
primitive or immutable graph representation here; the independent graph lane
owns that separate extension, which is not imported.

The primary should check every declaration and its axiom list, then distinguish:
viewed Force; nested viewed callables; rejected literal application typing;
value versus computation entry; wrap input/output order and inert argument;
request response binder; consumer-after-body order; scope/expose around request;
and arbitrary typed response under an outer bind. Any missing typed constructor,
typing premise in `Step`, prematurely executed carrier/input adapter, missing
request/context field or unsupported metadata-adequacy claim falsifies the
corresponding result. No checker, build or test was run by this author.

# Higher-order research core and structural embedding

Status: Draft research construction; checking and review evidence is recorded in
the sprint outcome and its frozen receipts. This is not production authority.
Scope: frozen LEAN-HIGHER-ORDER-PROOF-CORE-20261025/r1 research representation.
Initial author: /root/higher_order_proof_core_astra_r1; requested gpt-6-astra/medium,
observed model/effort UNKNOWN. Primary /root repairs and integrates after author
STOP; the outcome records final authorship and independent review. No descendants.
Production authority: none. The operational paper is a proposal/target; the
2026-10-07 complete-Call definition §1 records permission for legitimate research
definitions, not adoption of this representation as compiler architecture.

The parent RESPONSE-ENCODING-1 / ENV-CALLABLE-1 lacked a callable constructor in
its formal Value sort. The candidate removes that specific representational
obstruction by constructing a new callable type and actual lambda/wrap values.
Every Original.Val/Comp and TypedCall.Value/Comp/Adapter/Function constructor is
mapped structurally. No old term is retained behind an opaque original opcode.
The full parent, native readback and operational safety remain OPEN.

## Syntax and quantifiers

`HigherOrderSyntax.lean` retains every old type constructor, all eight literal
domains and their exact payload representations, variables, delay, injections,
single-child intersection/top values and all seven Original computations. It
adds the existing Call view/scope/expose/request/fail nodes, lambda/wrap values,
and dynamicCall. Request's continuation binds its operation instance's response
type. The type language can place callable types beneath thunk/union/intersection
and in operation instances. The value, computation and adapter syntax is mutually
inductive; all typing judgments are defined afterwards.

Value-entry lambda binds A; computation-entry lambda binds Thunk A. Both retain
receipt, annotated input/body/result types, body and result consumer. Wrap keeps
the input adapter c→a and output adapter b→d around an a→b function. DynamicCall
accepts a thunk carrier. This fixes a research typing interface without asserting
an execution rule or operational equivalence for the new constructor.

`ContextEmbedding old new` quantifies over every old lookup fact. The mutual
Original and TypedCall preservation proofs quantify over arbitrary old terms,
old typing derivations and target contexts satisfying that relation. Closed
Original nodes embed under any target context using the empty lookup relation;
binders use `extend_embedding`. The Function theorem quantifies over every old
FunctionTyped derivation and every target context. No original constructor,
source-domain restriction or independent continuation quantifier is discarded.
This is one-way typing preservation, not reflection or full conservativity.

## Metadata boundary

Paths retain component lists, port kinds and translated endpoint types;
occurrences retain identities and paths. Operation instances retain operation
identity, ordered type arguments and both payload/response types. Receipt slots
and profiles retain order, identity and typed paths. Adapter metadata retains
all path correspondences and captured occurrences. Interface-port metadata also
has a structural map.

PathRule is a Prop in the accepted input. `embedPathRule` translates its proof
into a new Prop proof. It does not eliminate that proof into a data-valued map
identity. In particular the old permissive adapterMap rule remains permissive;
this work cannot prove that a mappingIdentity absent from runtime data can be
reconstructed. Syntax is **typing-proof-free**, not entirely proof-free. The old
Adapter.typed field is omitted from syntax and consumed solely to construct the
new extrinsic AdapterTyped derivation. The retained PathRule metadata neither
contains a typing judgment nor creates a typing-definition cycle.

## Parent application

`embedFunction_typed` constructs a ValueTyped callable from an old FunctionTyped
proof. `function_as_argument` and `call_with_function_argument` use it in the
actual new delayed argument and dynamicCall constructors.
`request_callable_response` constructs a request that binds and returns a
callable-typed response. `function_cell` pushes the embedded function into the
existing generic NativeClosureEnvironment.Store, proves the actual current cell
equality and supplies its callable typing derivation.

`read_embedding` preserves the exact old selected cell address while mapping the
current store pointwise. `read_embedding_typed` combines that equation with the
accepted `successful_read_typed` theorem. `captured_value_typed` applies the
accepted `realized_substitution_typed` supplier to each represented context index;
`captured_body_typed` applies its actual successful capture and closed-body
construction before embedding. Both keep successful realization and CellsTyped
as explicit original premises. Nothing claims that arbitrary native closures
already satisfy those premises, or that old stores already represent new
callable values. Generic new callable storage and old represented-read transport
are two separate constructions whose native connection is still open.

## Remaining source obligations and reuse

Accepted CoreSyntax typing and CallEnvironmentRealization supply precisely their
existing domains. CoreSubstitution's bind/request lifting is reused through
close_body, without reproving lookup or assuming a new substitution rule. The
NativeClosureEnvironment.Store remains generic; no machine fields change.
Historical literal readback is not extended to callable readback by analogy.
No failure is dismissed by a narrower theorem; no new source restriction,
Simple-sub bypass or production implementation is introduced.

Luna/source intake owns ENV-LAYOUT-1 (resolved free-variable order and binder
indices from source Lambda/Name/Apply), ENV-CELL-VALUE-1 (current native Value

native body/consumer mapping, and ENV-DISPATCH-1. Relevant native owners remain

construction. The primary's disjoint source map gives their complete exact
producer/consumer inventory, including unit/record/default entry cases.
Force, native transitions, new-core substitution/progress/preservation,
whole-trace safety, operation authenticity and original inference A/B remain
OPEN. No F1/FK1 or foreign-continuation theorem is claimed here.

No Lean/build/tests/native checks were run by the author. A shell `python`

import YulangClosure.HigherOrderEntry

namespace YulangClosure.HigherOrder.Safety
open YulangClosure.HigherOrder

/-! Candidate operational research model. Events retain metadata syntactically;
no theorem below identifies this ledger with receipt/path/owner behavior. -/

inductive ThunkForm : Value → Prop where
  | delay (body : Comp) : ThunkForm (.delay body)
  | view : ThunkForm v → ThunkForm (.view v occurrence)

inductive CallableForm : Value → Prop where
  | lambda (mode receipt a b r body consumer) :
      CallableForm (.lambda mode receipt a b r body consumer)
  | wrap : CallableForm f → CallableForm (.wrap f input output)
  | view : CallableForm v → CallableForm (.view v occurrence)

inductive UnionForm : Value → Prop where
  | left (v : Value) : UnionForm (.inLeft v)
  | right (v : Value) : UnionForm (.inRight v)
  | view : UnionForm v → UnionForm (.view v occurrence)

inductive IntersectionForm : Value → Prop where
  | both (v : Value) : IntersectionForm (.both v)
  | view : IntersectionForm v → IntersectionForm (.view v occurrence)

theorem thunk_canonical (h : ValueTyped emptyContext v (.thunk a)) : ThunkForm v := by
  cases h with
  | var h => cases h
  | delay _ => exact .delay _
  | view h => exact .view (thunk_canonical h)

theorem callable_canonical (h : ValueTyped emptyContext v (.callable a b)) : CallableForm v := by
  cases h with
  | var h => cases h
  | lambdaValue _ _ => exact .lambda _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  | lambdaComputation _ _ => exact .lambda _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  | wrap h _ _ => exact .wrap (callable_canonical h)
  | view h => exact .view (callable_canonical h)

theorem union_canonical (h : ValueTyped emptyContext v (.union a b)) : UnionForm v := by
  cases h with
  | var h => cases h
  | inLeft _ => exact .left _
  | inRight _ => exact .right _
  | view h => exact .view (union_canonical h)

theorem intersection_canonical (h : ValueTyped emptyContext v (.intersection a b)) :
    IntersectionForm v := by
  cases h with
  | var h => cases h
  | both _ _ => exact .both _
  | view h => exact .view (intersection_canonical h)

theorem bottom_empty (h : ValueTyped emptyContext v .bottom) : False := by
  cases h with
  | var h => cases h
  | view h => exact bottom_empty h

/-- Complete annotations are retained as data, without claiming their semantic
adequacy. A view observation is an explicit transition, never silent erasure. -/
inductive Event where
  | silent
  | observeView (occurrence : ViewOccurrence)
  | lambdaEntry (plan : LambdaEntryPlan)
  | wrapEntry (plan : WrapEntryPlan)
  | leaveScope (owner : Nat)
  | leaveExpose (effectView resultView : ViewOccurrence)

/-- Independent operational rules: no rule contains a typing or safety premise.
Only the left side of bind and bodies of scope/expose are evaluation contexts. -/
inductive Step : Comp → Event → Comp → Prop where
  | force : Step (.force (.delay body)) .silent body
  | forceView : Step (.force (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.force v)
  | bindReturn : Step (.bind (.ret v) body) .silent (substComp (single v) body)
  | bind : Step m e n → Step (.bind m body) e (.bind n body)
  | unionLeft : Step (.unionCase (.inLeft v) l r) .silent (substComp (single v) l)
  | unionRight : Step (.unionCase (.inRight v) l r) .silent (substComp (single v) r)
  | unionView : Step (.unionCase (.view v o) l r) (.observeView o) (.unionCase v l r)
  | chooseLeft : Step (.chooseLeft (.both v)) .silent (.ret v)
  | chooseRight : Step (.chooseRight (.both v)) .silent (.ret v)
  | chooseLeftView : Step (.chooseLeft (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.chooseLeft v)
  | chooseRightView : Step (.chooseRight (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.chooseRight v)
  | scope : Step m e n → Step (.scope owner m) e (.scope owner n)
  | scopeReturn : Step (.scope owner (.ret v)) (.leaveScope owner) (.ret v)
  | expose : Step m e n → Step (.expose ev rv m) e (.expose ev rv n)
  | exposeReturn : Step (.expose ev rv (.ret v)) (.leaveExpose ev rv) (.ret v)
  | callView : Step (.dynamicCall (.view f o) arg) (.observeView o) (.dynamicCall f arg)
  | callLambda :
      Step (.dynamicCall (.lambda mode receipt a b r body consumer) carrier)
        (.lambdaEntry ⟨mode, receipt, a, b, r, body, consumer, carrier⟩)
        (LambdaEntryPlan.computation ⟨mode, receipt, a, b, r, body, consumer, carrier⟩)
  | callWrap :
      Step (.dynamicCall (.wrap inner input output) carrier)
        (.wrapEntry ⟨inner, input, output, carrier⟩)
        (WrapEntryPlan.computation ⟨inner, input, output, carrier⟩)

/-- Only explicit failure or an unhandled operation suspends execution. The
whole enclosing evaluation context and the original response binder remain. -/
inductive Suspended : Comp → Prop where
  | request (op payload continuation) : Suspended (.request op payload continuation)
  | fail (reason) : Suspended (.fail reason)
  | bind : Suspended m → Suspended (.bind m body)
  | scope : Suspended m → Suspended (.scope owner m)
  | expose : Suspended m → Suspended (.expose ev rv m)

inductive Returned : Comp → Prop where
  | ret (v : Value) : Returned (.ret v)

def CanProgress (m : Comp) : Prop :=
  Returned m ∨ Suspended m ∨ ∃ e n, Step m e n

theorem preservation (step : Step m e n) (h : CompTyped env m a) : CompTyped env n a := by
  induction step generalizing env a with
  | force =>
      cases h with
      | force hv => cases hv with | delay hb => exact hb
  | forceView =>
      cases h with
      | force hv => cases hv with | view hv => exact .force hv
  | bindReturn =>
      cases h with
      | bind hv hb => cases hv with | ret hv => exact substitute_top hb hv
  | bind _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | bind hm hb => exact .bind (ih hm) hb
  | unionLeft =>
      cases h with
      | unionCase hv hl _ => cases hv with | inLeft hv => exact substitute_top hl hv
  | unionRight =>
      cases h with
      | unionCase hv _ hr => cases hv with | inRight hv => exact substitute_top hr hv
  | unionView =>
      cases h with
      | unionCase hv hl hr => cases hv with | view hv => exact .unionCase hv hl hr
  | chooseLeft =>
      cases h with
      | chooseLeft hv => cases hv with | both hl _ => exact .ret hl
  | chooseRight =>
      cases h with
      | chooseRight hv => cases hv with | both _ hr => exact .ret hr
  | chooseLeftView =>
      cases h with
      | chooseLeft hv => cases hv with | view hv => exact .chooseLeft hv
  | chooseRightView =>
      cases h with
      | chooseRight hv => cases hv with | view hv => exact .chooseRight hv
  | scope _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | scope hm => exact .scope (ih hm)
  | scopeReturn =>
      cases h with
      | scope hm => exact hm
  | expose _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | expose hm => exact .expose (ih hm)
  | exposeReturn =>
      cases h with
      | expose hm => exact hm
  | callView =>
      cases h with
      | dynamicCall hf ha => cases hf with | view hf => exact .dynamicCall hf ha
  | callLambda =>
      cases h with
      | dynamicCall hf ha =>
          cases hf with
          | lambdaValue hb hc => exact lambda_value_plan_typed _ hb hc ha
          | lambdaComputation hb hc => exact lambda_computation_plan_typed _ hb hc ha
  | callWrap =>
      cases h with
      | dynamicCall hf ha =>
          cases hf with
          | wrap hf hi ho => exact wrap_plan_typed hf hi ho ha

theorem closed_progress (h : CompTyped emptyContext m a) : CanProgress m := by
  cases h with
  | ret _ => exact .inl (.ret _)
  | force hv =>
      cases thunk_canonical hv with
      | delay _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .force⟩)
      | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .forceView⟩)
  | bind hm hb =>
      rcases closed_progress hm with hr | hs | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases hr
        exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .bindReturn⟩)
      · exact .inr (.inl (.bind hs))
      · exact .inr (.inr ⟨e, _, .bind step⟩)
  | unionCase hv hl hr =>
      cases union_canonical hv with
      | left _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .unionLeft⟩)
      | right _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .unionRight⟩)
      | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .unionView⟩)
  | chooseLeft hv =>
      cases intersection_canonical hv with
      | both _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .chooseLeft⟩)
      | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .chooseLeftView⟩)
  | chooseRight hv =>
      cases intersection_canonical hv with
      | both _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .chooseRight⟩)
      | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .chooseRightView⟩)
  | absurd hv => exact False.elim (bottom_empty hv)
  | scope hm =>
      rcases closed_progress hm with hr | hs | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases hr
        exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .scopeReturn⟩)
      · exact .inr (.inl (.scope hs))
      · exact .inr (.inr ⟨e, _, .scope step⟩)
  | expose hm =>
      rcases closed_progress hm with hr | hs | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases hr
        exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .exposeReturn⟩)
      · exact .inr (.inl (.expose hs))
      · exact .inr (.inr ⟨e, _, .expose step⟩)
  | request _ _ => exact .inr (.inl (.request _ _ _))
  | fail => exact .inr (.inl (.fail _))
  | dynamicCall hf ha =>
      cases callable_canonical hf with
      | lambda _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .callLambda⟩)
      | wrap _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .callWrap⟩)
      | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .callView⟩)

theorem returned_no_step (h : Returned m) : ¬ Step m e n := by
  intro step
  cases h
  cases step

theorem suspended_no_step (h : Suspended m) : ¬ Step m e n := by
  intro step
  induction h generalizing e n with
  | request => cases step
  | fail => cases step
  | bind hs ih =>
      cases step with
      | bindReturn => cases hs
      | bind step => exact ih step
  | scope hs ih =>
      cases step with
      | scopeReturn => cases hs
      | scope step => exact ih step
  | expose hs ih =>
      cases step with
      | exposeReturn => cases hs
      | expose step => exact ih step

/-- Contexts capture only the actual evaluation positions; neither delayed
bodies nor request continuations are evaluated before their entry event. -/
inductive EvalContext where
  | hole
  | bind (inner : EvalContext) (body : Comp)
  | scope (owner : Nat) (inner : EvalContext)
  | expose (ev rv : ViewOccurrence) (inner : EvalContext)

def EvalContext.plug : EvalContext → Comp → Comp
  | .hole, m => m
  | .bind k body, m => .bind (k.plug m) body
  | .scope owner k, m => .scope owner (k.plug m)
  | .expose ev rv k, m => .expose ev rv (k.plug m)

inductive ContextTyped (env : Context) : EvalContext → Ty → Ty → Prop where
  | hole : ContextTyped env .hole a a
  | bind : ContextTyped env k a b → CompTyped (extend env b) body c →
      ContextTyped env (.bind k body) a c
  | scope : ContextTyped env k a b → ContextTyped env (.scope owner k) a b
  | expose : ContextTyped env k a b → ContextTyped env (.expose ev rv k) a b

theorem plug_typed (hk : ContextTyped env k a b) (hm : CompTyped env m a) :
    CompTyped env (k.plug m) b := by
  induction hk with
  | hole => exact hm
  | bind _ hb ih => exact .bind (ih hm) hb
  | scope _ ih => exact .scope (ih hm)
  | expose _ ih => exact .expose (ih hm)

theorem context_inversion (k : EvalContext) (h : CompTyped env (k.plug m) b) :
    ∃ a, CompTyped env m a ∧ ContextTyped env k a b := by
  induction k generalizing b with
  | hole => exact ⟨_, h, .hole⟩
  | bind k body ih =>
      cases h with
      | bind hm hb =>
          obtain ⟨a, hm, hk⟩ := ih hm
          exact ⟨a, hm, .bind hk hb⟩
  | scope owner k ih =>
      cases h with
      | scope hm =>
          obtain ⟨a, hm, hk⟩ := ih hm
          exact ⟨a, hm, .scope hk⟩
  | expose ev rv k ih =>
      cases h with
      | expose hm =>
          obtain ⟨a, hm, hk⟩ := ih hm
          exact ⟨a, hm, .expose hk⟩

/-- A suspension has a concrete failure or request at a finite context hole.
This is not an extra rule declaring arbitrary stuck terms terminal. -/
theorem suspended_decomposition (h : Suspended m) :
    (∃ k : EvalContext, ∃ reason, m = k.plug (.fail reason)) ∨
    (∃ k : EvalContext, ∃ op payload continuation, m = k.plug (.request op payload continuation)) := by
  induction h with
  | request op payload continuation =>
      exact .inr ⟨.hole, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
  | fail reason => exact .inl ⟨.hole, reason, rfl⟩
  | bind _ ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨k, reason, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
      · exact .inl ⟨.bind k _, reason, rfl⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨.bind k _, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
  | scope _ ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨k, reason, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
      · exact .inl ⟨.scope _ k, reason, rfl⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨.scope _ k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
  | expose _ ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨k, reason, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
      · exact .inl ⟨.expose _ _ k, reason, rfl⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨.expose _ _ k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩

/-- The finite trace stores every emitted event in execution order. -/
inductive Steps : Comp → List Event → Comp → Prop where
  | refl (m) : Steps m [] m
  | cons : Step m e n → Steps n trace last → Steps m (e :: trace) last

theorem trace_preservation (steps : Steps m trace n) (h : CompTyped env m a) :
    CompTyped env n a := by
  induction steps generalizing env a with
  | refl => exact h
  | cons step rest ih => exact ih (preservation step h)

/-- Quantifies over every finite prefix, not a selected successful execution. -/
theorem finite_prefix_safety (h : CompTyped emptyContext m a) (steps : Steps m trace n) :
    CompTyped emptyContext n a ∧ CanProgress n := by
  have hn := trace_preservation steps h
  exact ⟨hn, closed_progress hn⟩

/-- An actual operation response remains independently quantified. -/
theorem resume_request_typed
    (h : CompTyped env (.request op payload continuation) a)
    (response : Value) (hr : ValueTyped env response op.responseType) :
    CompTyped env (substComp (single response) continuation) a := by
  cases h with
  | request _ hk => exact substitute_top hk hr

/-- Independent response and enclosing-context quantifiers are both retained.
No local lambda action stands in for the foreign continuation. -/
theorem resume_in_context_typed (k : EvalContext)
    (h : CompTyped env (k.plug (.request op payload continuation)) a)
    (response : Value) (hr : ValueTyped env response op.responseType) :
    CompTyped env (k.plug (substComp (single response) continuation)) a := by
  obtain ⟨b, hm, hk⟩ := context_inversion k h
  exact plug_typed hk (resume_request_typed hm response hr)

/-- Viewed Force is represented explicitly, with the exact occurrence retained. -/
theorem viewed_force (v : Value) (o : ViewOccurrence) :
    Step (.force (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.force v) := .forceView

/-- Computation entry passes the original thunk without forcing it. -/
theorem computation_entry_equation (receipt a b r body consumer carrier) :
    (LambdaEntryPlan.mk .computation receipt a b r body consumer carrier).computation =
      .bind (substComp (single carrier) body) (adapterBody consumer) := rfl

/-- Value entry forces before body execution, then applies the result consumer. -/
theorem value_entry_equation (receipt a b r body consumer carrier) :
    (LambdaEntryPlan.mk .value receipt a b r body consumer carrier).computation =
      .bind (.bind (.force carrier) body) (adapterBody consumer) := rfl

/-- Input adaptation is inside the delayed carrier; output adaptation waits for
an inner result. This equation rules out premature argument adaptation. -/
theorem wrap_entry_equation (inner input output carrier) :
    (WrapEntryPlan.mk inner input output carrier).computation =
      .bind (.dynamicCall inner (.delay (.bind (.force carrier) (adapterBody input))))
        (adapterBody output) := rfl

end YulangClosure.HigherOrder.Safety
